## Profile

## Projects

- [ExamForge](https://github.com/pranav-pradeesh/ExamForge): Online exam and quiz
  platform. Teachers create exams, students take them, results are produced
  automatically. Built to replace a real workflow rather than as a demo.
- [Gas Guard](https://github.com/pranav-pradeesh/GAS-GUARD): IoT safety device —
  an Arduino with gas sensors that raises an alert when it detects a leak.
- [NMHSS Thirunavaya](https://github.com/pranav-pradeesh/nmhss-project): The
  official website for his school. Live in production with real users.
- [Orvaya](https://github.com/pranav-pradeesh/Orvaya): Client work — a responsive
  marketing website built for a real business.

## Stack

- **Languages:** C++, Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML, CSS
- **Web:** React, Node.js, MongoDB, Three.js
- **IoT / systems:** Arduino, sensors and actuators, Linux, Git
- **How he works:** AI-assisted development, rapid prototyping, shipping over
  polishing, reading docs at 2am

## Questions and answers

**Who is Pranav Pradeesh?**
A student developer from Kerala, India who started coding at 12 and builds web,
IoT and backend projects, most of them started to understand how something works.

**What has he built?**
Four shipped projects: ExamForge (exam platform), Gas Guard (Arduino gas-leak
detector), the NMHSS Thirunavaya school website (live in production), and Orvaya
(a client website).

**What technologies does he use?**
C++, Python, JavaScript and TypeScript; React, Node.js, MongoDB and Three.js on
the web; Arduino, sensors, Linux and Git for IoT and systems work.

**Is he available for work?**
Yes — he is looking for an internship in web development, IoT or backend, where
he can contribute and learn from more experienced engineers.

**How do you contact him?**
Email pranavpradeesh09@gmail.com, via GitHub at
https://github.com/pranav-pradeesh, or on LinkedIn at
https://www.linkedin.com/in/pranav-pradeesh-9994a640b/.

**Where is he based?**
Kerala, India.
